name: sentinel-workers
description: Autonomous Heat-Risk Prevention for Outdoor Workers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "api,dash,risk" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:risk"
scripts.dev:risk: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/risk-service --port 8000 --reload } else { uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/risk-service --port 8000 --reload }"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/schemas && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/policy && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/simulation && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/hydration-engine && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/scheduling-engine && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/fortyguard-provider && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/risk-engine && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/prediction-engine && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/action-engine && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/api && npm run build --workspace=@sentinel/dashboard
scripts.test:fortyguard: vitest run tests/unit/fortyguard-client.test.ts tests/unit/fortyguard-poller.test.ts tests/unit/fortyguard-cache.test.ts tests/unit/fortyguard-normalizer.test.ts tests/unit/fortyguard-security.test.ts tests/integration/fortyguard-hybrid-fallback.test.ts tests/integration/fortyguard-live.test.ts
scripts.test:python: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path .venv/Scripts/python.exe) { .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest apps/risk-service/tests } else { python -m pytest apps/risk-service/tests }"
